Czy działa na telefonie?: Does it work on a phone?
Tak, interfejs dopasowuje się do telefon: Yes. The interface adapts to your phone, and you can add it to your home screen as a web app. On iPhone, home-screen installation needs HTTPS with a trusted certificate.
Czy mogę wystawić instancję publicznie?: Can I put my installation on the public internet?
Tak, z włączonym logowaniem i HTTPS. Prz: Yes, with sign-in and HTTPS enabled. Set your username and password immediately on the first visit. Mode without sign-in is for a trusted LAN or VPN only. This website and demo are separate from your real finances.
Co mogę zrobić w demo?: What can I try in the demo?
Dodawać i edytować fikcyjne transakcje,: Add and edit sample transactions, set a budget, explore insights, and manage stores, goals and bills. Import uses a clearly labelled sample. Full CSV reading and recognition rules are available in your own installation. Reset demo brings the examples back.
Jak aktualizować i zabezpieczyć finanse?: How do I update and back up my data?
Aktualizacje wybierasz świadomie przez n: You choose when to update by selecting an image version. Back up the database and keep your configuration first. The documentation explains how to make and restore backups. A first-time installation creates an empty database automatically.
